name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new capability

labels: enhancement

## Problem
What user problem or gap does this address? A concrete scenario helps.

## Proposed solution
Describe the desired behaviour, CLI/subcommand if applicable, and how it fits
Wiktor's model (compiling retrieval database / two-plane store / QUG).

## Designs / alternatives
- (optional) any design spec, issue, or discussion thread this builds on.
- (optional) alternative approaches and why you prefer this one.

## Impact
Estimated scope (new crate / schema migration / new algorithm / docs-only) and
whether it touches the reliability contract (lease/idempotency/fencing).
